title: Carolane B NDE 7205
content: I was with a girlfriend of my age and two of my sisters, who were age 6 and 4 years old. We were sitting on a surrounding stonewall which had a height of approximately 4-5 meters (12-15 feet) at the back of the garden, and we were talking. The wall was old and not very strong anymore. At one moment, I leaned my hand on a stone on the right side of the wall and the stone fell and took me along in its fall. I closed my eyes while falling and after this, I felt like it was a black hole. I didn't feel pain and all was black around me yet I could still think. I asked myself, ‘Am I dreaming?’ There was no sound around me, all was calm and I wasn't scared, I felt good. It was as if I was sleeping, but still aware of everything. Then I heard crying. I figured out that it was my little sisters who were crying but I didn't feel any sorrow. Then I heard a voice that said, ‘You have to open your eyes, go on try.’ I could think and hear, but it was as if I couldn't control my body anymore, only my mind. All at once, I opened my eyes. I couldn't see well, everything looked fuzzy. I tried to get up but I lost my balance and fell back in a seated position. I felt something on my face and at that moment, I didn't know that it was my blood. I was told later that I had landed head first on the stone that fell with me. Then the mother of my friend, having been informed about my accident, came via another path and brought me to the hospital. I got stitches on my head and my nose was broken. I also remember that at the moment when I was unconscious, it was as if I was floating in the air in a lying position. I felt good, at peace. The duration of this seemed to last for hours, but I was told that I was unconscious for no more than ten minutes.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: While unconscious, it was 'as if I was floating in the air in a lying position.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Felt like 'a black hole' and 'all was black around me.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell from an old stonewall (about 4–5 meters / 12–15 feet) when a stone gave way; landed head first on a stone.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Falling/unconsciousness described as black void/black hole with calm awareness; later described floating in air; then a voice urged opening eyes leading to waking.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Heard sisters crying during the unconscious/black-void phase but felt no sorrow; heard a voice instructing, 'You have to open your eyes, go on try.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: ‘Am I dreaming?’; ‘You have to open your eyes, go on try.’
